verdicts.note: Full-year FY26 constant currency revenue growth reached 3.1%, meeting the 3% to 3.5% guidance band.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We had a growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.

verdicts.note: Full-year FY26 operating margin came in at 21%, within the guided 20% to 22% range.
verdicts.evidence_quote: Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%.

verdicts.note: Guidance revised to 1.5%-3% in Jul 2026 and further lowered to 1%-2% in Oct 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY .in constant currency terms.

verdicts.note: FY27 is ongoing; operating margin guidance of 20% to 22% was reiterated through Q2 FY27.
verdicts.evidence_quote: Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.

verdicts.note: FY27 is ongoing; company hired about 13,000 freshers in H1 towards the 20,000 target.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We hired about 13,000 freshers in H1 in line with our target of approximately 20,000 for FY27.
